source_text: Tunc festinaverunt duces Edom et principes Moabitarum; tabuerunt omnes habitatores Chanaan. Timor Dei dissolvit arrogantiam gentium.
pass_a_gloss: Then hastened leaders of-Edom and princes of-Moabites; melted all inhabitants of-Canaan. Fear of-God dissolves arrogance of-nations.
pass_b_english: [[Then the chiefs of Edom hurried, and the princes of Moab; all Canaan’s dwellers melted >> Bible:Exodus 15:15]]. Fear of God dissolves the nations’ arrogance.
